approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: A TXT or Email Submittal with multiple explicit statuses currently keeps only the first status in its workflow context.
The existing workflow index already marks multiple statuses from one source ambiguous, but the parser must preserve every distinct canonical status for that exact primary identifier.
Reuse the current status normalizer and ambiguity calculation; add no dependency, semantic inference, mailbox access or model call.
Offline parser, workflow and API regressions, specification sync and every bounded task context pack passed before completion.
title: Single-source Submittal status conflicts
objective: Preserve every distinct explicit status for one exact Submittal source so an Email or TXT conflict reaches the existing AMBIGUOUS workflow review state.
